import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 1000005;
    static int n, k, p;
    static int[] fac = new int[MAXN], invFac = new int[MAXN];
    static int[][] dp = new int[2][MAXN], f = new int[MAXN];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        p = sc.nextInt();

        int tempN = n;
        int maskVal = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            if (((n >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                maskVal |= (1 << i);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= maskVal; i++) {
            int t = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                if (((n >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    t <<= 1;
                    t |= ((i >> j) & 1);
                }
            }
            f[t] = i;
        }

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(modPow(BigInteger.valueOf(k), BigInteger.valueOf(n), BigInteger.valueOf(p)).intValue());
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) {
            fac[i] = (int)((long)fac[i - 1] * i % p);
        }
        invFac[MAXN - 1] = modInverse(fac[MAXN - 1], p);
        for (int i = MAXN - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            invFac[i] = (int)((long)invFac[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p);
        }

        int size = maskVal + 1;
        int[] a = new int[size];
        for (int i = 0; i <= maskVal; i++) {
            a[i] = invFac[f[i]];
        }

        int res = modPow(BigInteger.valueOf(k), BigInteger.valueOf(n), BigInteger.valueOf(p)).intValue();

        a = subsetPowerConvolution(a, k, p);

        int subtractVal = (int)((long)a[maskVal] * fac[n] % p);
        res = (res - subtractVal + p) % p;

        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }

    static BigInteger modPow(BigInteger base, BigInteger exp, BigInteger mod) {
        return base.modPow(exp, mod);
    }

    static int modInverse(int a, int m) {
        return BigInteger.valueOf(a).modInverse(BigInteger.valueOf(m)).intValue();
    }

    static void performTransform(int[] a, int n, int p, boolean invert) {
        int logn = Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros(n) ^ 31;
        for (int i = 0; i < logn; i++) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < n; mask++) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    int prev = mask ^ (1 << i);
                    if (!invert) {
                        a[mask] = (a[mask] + a[prev]) % p;
                    } else {
                        a[mask] = (a[mask] - a[prev] + p) % p;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] powerConvolution(int[] a, int k, int p) {
        int n = a.length;
        if (k == 1) return a;
        if (k % 2 == 1) {
            int[] temp = powerConvolution(a, k - 1, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j + i < n; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (int)((res[i + j] + (long)temp[i] * a[j]) % p);
                }
            }
            return res;
        } else {
            int[] half = powerConvolution(a, k / 2, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j + i < n; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (int)((res[i + j] + (long)half[i] * half[j]) % p);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static int[] subsetPowerConvolution(int[] a, int k, int p) {
        final int LOGN = 19;
        int n = a.length;
        int size = 1;
        while (size < n) size <<= 1;
        int[][] fa = new int[LOGN][size];
        int[][] fc = new int[LOGN][size];

        for (int i = 0; i < LOGN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(fa[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(fc[i], 0);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i && j < a.length) {
                    fa[i][j] = a[j];
                }
            }
            performTransform(fa[i], size, p, false);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int[] v = new int[LOGN];
            for (int j = 0; j < LOGN; j++) v[j] = fa[j][i];
            v = powerConvolution(v, k, p);
            for (int j = 0; j < LOGN; j++) fc[j][i] = v[j];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < LOGN; i++) {
            performTransform(fc[i], size, p, true);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i && j < a.length) {
                    a[j] = fc[i][j];
                }
            }
        }
        return a;
    }
}
